summary: 多币种/汇率（WP-FX）契约冻结首片 on BASE 15cf20c, docs-only. Per Lead ruling C (the BASE PH-308 exact allowlist has no docs/adr entry and the spec itself asks for contract freeze rather than an ADR file), the frozen multi-currency/FX contract is written into project/specs/PH-308.md instead of creating docs/adr/0015-multi-currency-fx.md. The frozen text covers: reporting currency (org-level CNY) vs functional currency (ISO 4217 on every money fact, frozen in terms/confirmation snapshots); append-only versioned FX rate snapshots keyed by organization/base/quote/business effective date/source/version with Decimal rate (no float, unique effective version, no lookback fallback, no reciprocal auto-derivation, missing rate rendered as missing); conversion boundary semantics (convert once at each boundary, persist fx_rate_ref plus original currency/amount, ROUND_HALF_UP to integer cents exactly once, aggregate already-rounded cents, never sum originals then convert, no client-supplied converted amounts); cross-owner ownership boundaries (contracts owns functional-currency contract lines/terms, settlement owns settlement/open-item/clearance currency plus fx ref, management_revenue derives reporting read-only from approved terms, cash stays bank-currency with foreign cash/exchange gain-loss explicitly out of scope, costing/time unchanged); read-only display/reconciliation rules (show original + reporting values and rate ref, missing never 0/default rate, stable issue codes required when implemented, role rules owner/finance rates, auditor read, pm project summary, member denied, disabled-module history read, unauth 403); canonical/API/migration boundaries (no new canonical/model/migration/route in this slice, PH-321 implementation must plan any new canonical and migrate via explicit migration, no implicit recomputation of history); 12 rejection cases; acceptance/completion and an explicit not-implemented list. No product code, model, migration, schema, route, canonical event or docs/adr file was written; no existing write path or business fact changed. Reviewer round-1 blocker fixed by option A: the frozen contract no longer assumes the existing CNY-only canonical entities can persist foreign functional currency. PH-308 spec now has §9A 'required canonical extension' registering proposed task PH-324 (canonical currency/original-amount fields or Money type for contracts/settlement/management_revenue/cash/invoicing entities, additive migration with currency='CNY' backfill, dual-read compatibility, non-CNY writes rejected until backfill, explicit migration-only recomputation, PG coverage, release order PH-324 -> PH-321); PH-321 depends_on now includes PH-324; before PH-324 only CNY facts/read-only display are allowed and non-CNY writes must not start. PH-324 is proposed with spec pointing at PH-308 §9A until the planning slot can split its own spec file (PH-308 allowlist has no new spec path).

review.reviewer: independent PH-308 multi-currency/FX contract reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - the frozen contract requires per-fact functional currency, but the canonical schemas it claims to preserve have CNY-only amount fields and no currency: `Invoice`/`InvoiceLine`/`InvoiceAllocation`/`InvoiceReversal`/`ContractLine`/`Settlement`/`RevenueRecognition`/cash facts all use `CnyCents` (or equivalent integer CNY cents) and have no `currency`/`functional_currency` property. Section 2 says every amount fact must persist an ISO 4217 functional currency and the original-currency amount, while the same spec says it does not change contract schema and section 7 defers any canonical addition to later planning without registering that required canonical/type extension. A USD/HKD invoice or settlement cannot be represented in the frozen canonical entities, so the contract is not implementable as stated. Fix: explicitly freeze the canonical/schema extension needed for functional currency (a currency field/type on the affected entities or a separate FX amount representation), the old-`CnyCents` compatibility/backfill rule, and the planning/task/whitelist that will perform that contract change; or narrow this freeze to read-only CNY reporting and mark multi-currency facts as requiring a canonical schema change before PH-321.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: CNY reporting currency vs functional currency, append-only/versioned FX snapshots with (org, base, quote, effective_on, version) uniqueness, Decimal/no-float, no recent-rate fallback/inverse guessing, missing-not-zero, boundary-once conversion with fx_rate_ref/original amount, ROUND_HALF_UP once and no aggregate-then-convert, cross-owner ownership boundaries, read-only display/issue/missing, role matrix/history_read, no implicit historical recompute, and 12 counterexamples are frozen coherently; the spec is docs-only, whitelist is exactly the 6 spec/tasks/manifest/docs/verification/report/handoff paths, no docs/adr/code/migration/schema/route/canonical change, PH-308 in_review/handoff and PH-321 remains proposed; Lead's decision to freeze in the spec rather than an ADR is disclosed. check ok=245; governance 23 OK; verify-change --base 15cf20c --task PH-308 only high_risk_review_required, no path_out_of_scope.
